statement: The reduced matrix is the actual partial trace of the rank-one density. Unitary permutation actions and the original simultaneous fixed-vector equation give conjugation invariance. For the actual excitation component, fixedness is derived by the proved stabilizer identity. No component or marginal invariance certificate, normalization, independent-copy hypothesis or merge-moment estimate is assumed. Empty registers, zero vectors and zero copies are included. Selection and regrouping of the specific good-copy marginal and the moment estimate remain separate.
